doc.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998

title: Notable Potsdam students including Renee Fleming
summary: Students Renee Fleming, Gary Keller and others.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: You turned out, you had some students that went on to become pretty well known.
Renee Fleming is a world famous vocal soloist at the Met. She sang with my band, her first gig singing. No, no she sang in beer joints in Potsdam, but singing with a band, she sang with my band.
Glenn Drews, Gary Keller, Gary Burke, Bruce Petrucci — a lot of well known musicians. Mike DiMeo.
